name: Kuchiki Chizuru
source:
Touko's mother. A taciturn, gloomy lady who seems rather frail. Doesn't get out much; she devotes all her time to her household duties.

[Edited from [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/r18/Titles/Details/359B59DA-2B1C-4FD1-8574-58C8343CF220/kara-no-shoujo]MangaGamer[/url]]

[spoiler]Chizuru is Touko's adoptive mother, taking her in as a foster child during her early years. At first, Chizuru earnestly worked on building a mother-daughter bond. However, as Touko grew older and more beautiful, Chizuru noticed her brother, Fumiya, becoming attracted to Touko. This realization caused a rift to develop in their relationship. For Chizuru, her brother was her entire world, and the agony of feeling him drawn to Touko was unbearable.[/spoiler]
